notes.title: ODDLI Demo Coming June 1st 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
  
We’re incredibly excited to announce that the ODDLI demo will be launching on June 1st, just in time to warm up for Steam Next Fest! 🎮✨
  
Whether you're into satisfying movement puzzles, adorable toylike characters, or cozy vibes with a clever twist — this one's for you.

  What is ODDLI?  

ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating mesmerizing loops with your own movement.
      Create your own ODDLI satisfying loops    Explore surreal, handcrafted biomes    Enjoy a calming original soundtrack    Watch your characters repeat your every move    
What to Expect in the Demo      10 Levels in 5 different environments + A secret endless level!    Bonus challenges and hidden stars    A sneak peek at different game modes    A polished slice of what’s coming later this year   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499258/6e590d1150b941b1411e6aded8501d84865077cb.jpg

Available Early for Creators  
Are you a content creator? Reach out on our website to request early access.

Help Us Spread the Word      👉 Wishlist now!    👉 Follow us for updates  Tiktok Instagram 👉 Tell a friend who loves cozy games!  
Stay tuned — we can’t wait to see the loops you’ll create.
– Team Tight Fit
